transcript: Trust with yourself does not happen without full sacrifice. You have to be willing to let it all go. In order to see yourself from the external perspective, in order to see yourself through the mirror for who you truly are, you have to be able to let it all go. You have to let your past go. In order to shift to the other side and deconstruct and heal, we have to be able to see who we truly are. And sometimes that looks like icky. That does not look good. That does not feel good. When we hold ourselves accountable, sometimes that really, really sucks. But life requires us to move without judgment. It requires us to move at different paces. Sometimes we walk. Sometimes we have to sprint. We have to readjust as necessary.
